description: This file contains logic for resolving implicit provider configurations in an OpenClaw project, including plugin discovery, provider merging, and timeout handling.

methods.name: resolveLiveProviderCatalogTimeoutMs
methods.description: Determines the timeout in milliseconds for live provider catalog resolution based on environment variables.

methods.name: resolveLiveProviderDiscoveryFilter
methods.description: Filters provider IDs for live discovery based on environment variables.

methods.name: mergeImplicitProviderSet
methods.description: Merges a set of provider configurations into a target record.

methods.name: mergeImplicitProviderConfig
methods.description: Merges existing and implicit provider configurations, applying specific mergers if defined.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredImplicitProvider
methods.description: Resolves a provider configuration from a list of provider IDs and configured providers.

methods.name: resolveExistingImplicitProviderFromContext
methods.description: Resolves a provider configuration from the context, checking explicit and configured providers.

methods.name: resolvePluginImplicitProviders
methods.description: Discovers plugin providers based on order and environment, with timeout handling.

methods.name: buildPluginCatalogConfig
methods.description: Builds a combined configuration including explicit providers.

methods.name: runProviderCatalogWithTimeout
methods.description: Runs provider catalog discovery with a timeout, handling errors and logging.

methods.name: resolveImplicitProviders
methods.description: Main exported function to resolve all implicit providers based on environment and configuration.
